CameraClick requires Accessibility permissions to function properly. This permission allows the app to remotely and programmatically tap your camera\'s shutter button. No personal data is collected or stored. Accessibility access is strictly used to enable the remote camera control feature.
This service turns your Garmin watch into a remote camera trigger
